Fresh Start Law Centre

By: Liz Fish | Delivery

Proposal


Show:

Unique Selling Point:
A criminal record can really set you back, if you want to travel, need a visa or a job. It’s very quick and easy for anyone to find out if you have one, and many employers require that you have a clear record. It can affect the kind of job you can get or even promotion and in today’s economic climate jobs are hard enough to come by. Fresh Start Law Centre says they will take away the hassal of dealing with the SAPS and the Department of Justice in record time - but there is no magic in the system and after parting with large sums of money you discover you could have done it yourself for free

Summary:
In May 2009 the Criminal Procedures Act was amended- people with minor criminal charges against them that were more than 10 years old could apply to the Department of Justice to have their names cleared and removed from the National Criminal data base. This process can take anything from 4-6 months. For a more serious crime that it older than 10 years old you have to apply for a Presidential pardon which can take far longer, anything from 2 to 3 years. And of course because it’s a Government department and people don’t want to be bothered they use agencies’ like Fresh Start Law Centre

Further information:
Fresh Start has officers in Cape Town and Johannesburg. When you apply online they are very quick to give you a call and find out your details and begin the process. They claim to be a law firm when they are not, they do not have any attorneys working in the company, nor are they registered as a practicing law firm. Clients in Cape Town can have their fingerprints taken at their office and then the fingerprints are then signed off at a later stage by a commissioner of oath, when the applicant is not in their presence, tat is illegal. They advertise that they are able to prioritize expungement applications and have it fast tracked in the department of justice, they charge the public an additional R3200 to do this. They also do the same for police clearance certificate and charge the public an additional R1200 to fast track police clearances. They've been advised by the department that they will not fast track, however they continue to charge the public and maintain that they're able to do it. They've made fraudulent applications to obtain a high court order by the CEO's instruction. The CEO intimidates and threatens clients and staff alike. They charge clients R14 000 to do high court applications for setting aside of admission of guilt fines, but these are not done by an attorney, but rather an individual who has absolutely no legal qualifications. All sales reps claim to be paralegals, none of them are. They charge client's for services which they know they're unable to complete.
Once you have paid your money and after the initial consultation you get onto a members portal to track your progress. But former employees tell us that just a gimmick and means nothing. For many applicants they never get a result. We have case studies who did finally get a clearance only to find out when they went for a job interview they were still on the national criminal register.
David Ansar Sykes the CEO of Fresh Start Law Centre is also alleged to have avoided paying SARS between 2014-2017 in a scheme where he pays his staff money and then deposits it back into the company as a loan- we have the email instructing them to do that and a whatsapp where he says it will save them R100 000 in tax. There is also a Pay Pal trail where he removes the company money into his private account.


Extra Budget Items:
extra half day with presenter
We did our first half day In Pretoria with the Department of Justice last Thursday which went very well and established clearly what the procedure is for people seeking expungement and an essential part of the story. In Cape Town I need to interview two strong case studies, but they are on opposite sides of the peninsular, one in Parow the other Stand. One paid R15 000 and the other R17 000, neither got any joy from Fresh start, never heard anything back at all. And the third wants to hide their identity so I need Masa for that. Then there are two former employees critical to the inside operations. Jerome November was fired because he would not continue to pose as the attorney. He will give us an interview and then we will accompany him as he serves papers on them- he just won a court settlement for 1 months pay and 5 months retrenchment. Then I have to track down Ansar Skyes the CEO to two different addresses to confront him and to film Jerome. I cannot achieve all this and film links in 1.5 days and so am requesting two full days in Cape Town, especially as CB have gone to the expense of flying Masa down here. Confronting people who are on the move takes time and persistence and is not predictable. Day 1 in Cape Town is to film two cases studies and staff member and links. Day 2 is to interview Jerome. Then we go and walk into their officers to confront Skyes and the film Jerome delivering papers after that. If that doesn’t work then go to Ansar home address and then to the Century City officers where they collect documents. Friday will be a day of running around trying to pin him down, interviews and links. If it was a straight forward situation of just doing interviews at set times an locations it would be more straight forward.

Script:


Link “Having a criminal record wreaks havoc on people’s lives and for many they were minor offences, but it makes getting a job really difficult, and travel and immigration impossible.”
Script: Lizzy Botha’s son turned to her for help when he discovered that the dagga he had been caught with at 19, and paid a R300 fine for, had earned him a criminal record
Lizzy: So as he progressed in his military career, when it got to a point where he needed to get promoted it was then brought to the attention that he had a criminal record and they couldn't promote him.
Script: Finding Fresh Start Law Centre online- it promised he could leave the past in the past, in as little as 45 days, with a 99.95% success rate and a 100% money back guarantee, and for an extra fee, they could fast track the process
Lizzy: That was In July 2017 when he contacted them the first time and they were very eager and quick to help
Script: The criminal procedures act was amended in 2009 so that people with minor criminal records could get them expunged 10 years after the offence. Liana Niewvoudt, of the Department of Justice Expungements explains who qualifies
Liana: That will be offenses like negligent driving, driving under the influence, minor assaults, your small offenses for which you regularly or normally would not have to serve a period of direct imprisonment.
Script: But there is no point applying under 10 years, which Lizzy son didn’t know when Fresh Start Law Centre promised they could solve his problem, his offence was committed 6 years before
Masa “Did they explain to him that they can get it expunged if it's no less than 10 years?
Lizzy “Not at all, they were adamant it is all fine and they gave him an initial quote, not a problem this is a strong case, we can definitely get it removed.
Script: Judging from the number of complaints we have received and the scores more on Hello Peter he wasn’t alone. In the beginning, Fresh Start is efficient at collecting your documents and fingerprints and chasing payments. But after that it seems you go into a void when phone calls and emails go unanswered. The personal barometer to track real time progress is fake, the Department of Justice doesn't give updates. Fresh Start Law Centre biggest draw card is that they tell clients that they can do it faster than their competitors for an extra fee, because they have dedicated officials within the Department of Justice
Masa “Does Fresh Start have dedicated agents within the department
Liana” No, there is no dedicated official. Each application, irrespective of where we receive it, either from members of the public, from an agency or a law firm, each application has a dedicated official that is responsible to take that specific application from the beginning to the end. Liana [01:08:50].It's a first come, first serve process
Script: Sometimes people have criminal record if the charges were dropped against them and this information wasn’t updated at the criminal records centre, or they paid an admission of guilt fine and unbeknown to them this reflects as a criminal record.
Lizzy “ then they came back was about two months later. This is a high court case. We are going to require another fourteen thousand five hundred from you in order for us to submit this to a high court so we can get it removed through the high court.
Script: Having a criminal record is not something one bandies about, let’s say this man is called Brian, he was under strict instructions from his employer not to reveal his identity
Ashley I couldn't find any programing work because no company would hire me just because of my record the moment they see it, they just throw my CV out, they don't even bother looking at it further.
Script: At 21 Brian was picked up for having two mariwana joints and paid an admission of guilt fine of R700. When he went to the police station to see if he qualified for an expungement they told him to contact Fresh Start Law Centre
Masa “So when you did approach them, what did they offer you?
ashley “The first thing they offered me is just the basic expungement, just to try and clear it, which was this often only once the ten years have been done. And then later on, they tried to reveal like we can expand it quicker timeline, but you'd have to pay an excess.
Script: Brian was persuaded that they could get his record expunged sooner if they approach the high court.
Masa “ How much did you pay in total? “
Ashley “ About seventeen thousand and seventeen thousand rand. And how long has it been since you applied? Ashley [12:26:51] Now it's going on about three or four years.Not at all…. I came to a point where I had to empty out my provident fund . Now it's been blown away.
Script: Clients were told this man was the inhouse attorney, and although he has a master’s in law he isn’t an admitted attorney which you need to be to do High Court applications. When he objected the CEO Ansar Sykes fired him, but his qualifications were kept the wall
Masa “Did you ever express concern about them wanting you to act as an attorney.
Jerome ”On several occasions Mr. Sykes then came to the office and he spoke to me. I told him this under no circumstances will I allow him to be seen as as the attorney of the place. Mr. Sykes, however, was quite adamant that I should then just ward off the complaints and say that the attorney is working on the case in order to make sure that the delay is then justified.
Script: Michelle Ortmann was the former COO, she was fired at the same time. She objected to the increasing levels of deceit and the upselling of services they could not deliver
Michelle “So what we were told with regards to the signatures ..The Department of Justice won't accept scanned signatures.[11:47:01] So they made us stand up against a glass window with the back, with the signature behind and with the light being able to trace the signature, which we were told to do.
Link: “Clients used to be able to go into the Fresh Start office but now that has all changed. Despite advertising officers in all the major centres you can no longer actually speak to any of the staff directly if you have a complaint. Now you can only drop off documents at various Regus offices.
Script: On the Fresh Start website they show these grand officers in all the main hubs, which are in fact Regus officers, who rent hotdesks and temporary office space in good locations.
Masa [15:02:05] Do you have any idea as to why they closed all their walk in offices?
Jerome “Staff was then threatened, staff were even assaulted and then staff were basically told or they were demanding their money back Mr. Sykes decided to go underground and do his operation where nobody would be but able to access the business
Script. Tenant Profile Network were shocked when they discovered their logo on Fresh Start Law Centre website, they had used them to run criminal record checks for some of their clients, and for employment purposes, but they weren’t satisfied
Michelle “We cancelled services, so we have not had any dealings with Fresh Start since 2017
Masa “How do you feel when you discovered Fresh Start had your logo on their website
Michellle “Quite, quite angry. And because we don't to work with a fresh start, we haven't done work with Fresh Start in over three years. And I feel our brand is being played off in terms of brand awareness in the market.
Masa “One of the things they say on their Web site is 100 percent money back guarantee. Did you ever get your money back?
Ashley “Zero. Absolutely nothing.
Jerome “When I worked there not in one single instance was money given back to a client.
Michelle “What would happen is they would say to me a client would like a refund. Then refund situation would be your need to e-mail Jenny Blackwell at the Joburg office. Jenny Blackwell was a fictitious persona. She was never a proper individual
Script: And some have paid as much as R25000 without results. It was time to speak to the Mr Ansar Sykes
Masa “We have been forced to come to Mr Sykes home because he initially responded to our emails and then started avoiding us right now he is clearly in his home his car is here and his wife’s car is here but he is not responding to us again
Script: Next, we tried Fresh Start secret office. We had a strong lead. Ansar Skyes and other staff had been seen entering these premises on a regular basis
Masa” Morning- how are you- – have you heard of Fresh Start- no what do they do 13 43 00 Who is your boss? My boss his name is um Adam- Adam Who- Adam Smith – Can we get his contact details- no sorry they are confidential and Unfortunately I need to remove you off the property- you have to remove us and why is that- because he can see you on the cameras – oh so he is here- he is not here – if I do hear from him or anything then I will mention it to him but I don’t know a man of Ansa David Smith um sorry David Sykes
Script: They do actually, with a bit more digging we found out WhatsAPI is owned by Ansar Sykes. An hour later he called us
Ansar “ This needs to be run through the managing director. The person that owns the company.
Masa “Yeah, but you were the person who owned the company when these complaints were made.
Ansar “ But I'm asked to run it because my terms of exit were quite a substantial non-disclosure.
Masa [13:49:11] But then you can answer to the questions of some of the things that happened at the time that you were there while you were there.
Ansar [13:50:48] OK are you able to send me specifics to prepare [14:34:44] So I'll give Angela a call and find out what she has to say.
Masa [14:34:49] Angela who, Mr. Sykes. Angela, who is sort of Angela Finlay , Can you give us her contact number? No, I'm going to call . Do you have an e-mail address
Script. We emailed the list of clients who were owed over R80 000 between them, to both Sykes and the MD – her email bounced back, so we tracked her down. Turns out Angela Finlay is a vets receptionist and lives with Sykes mother. They needed financial help, so in return for R2500 month for groceries, she agreed to be signed on as a Director.
Angela ” I did become a managing director with a fresh start. I have not bought his business And I also did not, make him sign any non-disclosure at all. When you phoned me, it was the first I heard of any of this. I'm totally shocked and appalled by all of this.
Script: The email from Fresh Start claims Sykes doesn’t work there anymore, yet this email sent on the 6th March and Angela say otherwise. And as for responding to the clients complaints they say the Covert 19 virus has put pay to that, and our complaints fall in 05% and they stand by their 99.95%
Masa “Is it even necessary to use an agent
Liana “No, it's not necessary. It's a very simple process. The form was designed specifically with lay people in mind. Just fill in the form and then we can start with an application.
Lizzy "If I look at the year that we went through. And I look at the hell my son went through and the money that was laid out and the emotional roller coaster, it was. All the promises and the phone calls.
Ashley “ They actually gave me hope, thinking that they would do it. And then pretty much as felt like being stabbed in the back at the end.
Script: Lizzy sorted out her son’s clearance in 4 weeks dealing directly with the High Court and it cost her nothing.
Lizzy “ All of that was completely and totally unnecessary. Plus, we were actually refunded the money that he had paid to the police force.

metadata.Unique Selling Point: A criminal record can really set you back, if you want to travel, need a visa or a job. It’s very quick and easy for anyone to find out if you have one, and many employers require that you have a clear record. It can affect the kind of job you can get or even promotion and in today’s economic climate jobs are hard enough to come by. Fresh Start Law Centre says they will take away the hassal of dealing with the SAPS and the Department of Justice in record time - but there is no magic in the system and after parting with large sums of money you discover you could have done it yourself for free
metadata.Summary: In May 2009 the Criminal Procedures Act was amended- people with minor criminal charges against them that were more than 10 years old could apply to the Department of Justice to have their names cleared and removed from the National Criminal data base. This process can take anything from 4-6 months. For a more serious crime that it older than 10 years old you have to apply for a Presidential pardon which can take far longer, anything from 2 to 3 years. And of course because it’s a Government department and people don’t want to be bothered they use agencies’ like Fresh Start Law Centre
metadata.Further information: Fresh Start has officers in Cape Town and Johannesburg. When you apply online they are very quick to give you a call and find out your details and begin the process. They claim to be a law firm when they are not, they do not have any attorneys working in the company, nor are they registered as a practicing law firm. Clients in Cape Town can have their fingerprints taken at their office and then the fingerprints are then signed off at a later stage by a commissioner of oath, when the applicant is not in their presence, tat is illegal. They advertise that they are able to prioritize expungement applications and have it fast tracked in the department of justice, they charge the public an additional R3200 to do this. They also do the same for police clearance certificate and charge the public an additional R1200 to fast track police clearances. They've been advised by the department that they will not fast track, however they continue to charge the public and maintain that they're able to do it. They've made fraudulent applications to obtain a high court order by the CEO's instruction. The CEO intimidates and threatens clients and staff alike. They charge clients R14 000 to do high court applications for setting aside of admission of guilt fines, but these are not done by an attorney, but rather an individual who has absolutely no legal qualifications. All sales reps claim to be paralegals, none of them are. They charge client's for services which they know they're unable to complete. Once you have paid your money and after the initial consultation you get onto a members portal to track your progress. But former employees tell us that just a gimmick and means nothing. For many applicants they never get a result. We have case studies who did finally get a clearance only to find out when they went for a job interview they were still on the national criminal register. David Ansar Sykes the CEO of Fresh Start Law Centre is also alleged to have avoided paying SARS between 2014-2017 in a scheme where he pays his staff money and then deposits it back into the company as a loan- we have the email instructing them to do that and a whatsapp where he says it will save them R100 000 in tax. There is also a Pay Pal trail where he removes the company money into his private account.
metadata.Extra Budget Items: extra half day with presenter We did our first half day In Pretoria with the Department of Justice last Thursday which went very well and established clearly what the procedure is for people seeking expungement and an essential part of the story. In Cape Town I need to interview two strong case studies, but they are on opposite sides of the peninsular, one in Parow the other Stand. One paid R15 000 and the other R17 000, neither got any joy from Fresh start, never heard anything back at all. And the third wants to hide their identity so I need Masa for that. Then there are two former employees critical to the inside operations. Jerome November was fired because he would not continue to pose as the attorney. He will give us an interview and then we will accompany him as he serves papers on them- he just won a court settlement for 1 months pay and 5 months retrenchment. Then I have to track down Ansar Skyes the CEO to two different addresses to confront him and to film Jerome. I cannot achieve all this and film links in 1.5 days and so am requesting two full days in Cape Town, especially as CB have gone to the expense of flying Masa down here. Confronting people who are on the move takes time and persistence and is not predictable. Day 1 in Cape Town is to film two cases studies and staff member and links. Day 2 is to interview Jerome. Then we go and walk into their officers to confront Skyes and the film Jerome delivering papers after that. If that doesn’t work then go to Ansar home address and then to the Century City officers where they collect documents. Friday will be a day of running around trying to pin him down, interviews and links. If it was a straight forward situation of just doing interviews at set times an locations it would be more straight forward.
